seo.defaultDescription: Lexbell is the private desktop case management software for attorneys, immigration consultants, and real estate professionals on Mac & Windows. 100% offline and confidential.

home.heroSubtitle: The desktop software built for attorneys, immigration consultants, and real estate advisers. Manage court litigation, visas, and contracts on Mac and Windows with instant speed. Your files never leave your computer and work 100% offline.
home.heroCard1Desc: All matters and client data remain solely on your machine. Zero vendor cloud storage and inviolable confidentiality.
home.heroCard2Desc: Automatic detection of adverse parties and corporate or family links before accepting new matters.
home.heroCard3Desc: Strict tracking of statutory deadlines and hearings with native alerts that work completely offline.
home.heroCard4Desc: Start free up to 50 matters without entering a credit card. No recurring monthly SaaS fees.
home.audTitle: Designed specifically for your industry workflows.
home.audSubtitle: Whether litigating in courts, filing residency and visas, or managing rental leases and real estate, Lexbell adapts with custom fields tailored to your profession.
home.audTab1Title: Strict docket tracking, hearing schedule, and court deadlines.
home.audTab1Desc: Manage Civil, Criminal, Labor, Administrative, and Commercial matters. Track docket numbers, assigned courts, and opposing parties with native deadline reminders.
home.audTab1Point1: Court calendar linked directly to each case and statutory cutoff.
home.audTab1Point2: Automated conflict of interest detection with relationship graphs.
home.audTab1Point3: Inviolable confidentiality with local AES-256 SQLite encryption.
home.audTab2Title: Track visa and residency filings without missing a deadline.
home.audTab2Desc: Engineered for professionals handling consular petitions and immigration benefits. Track NVC Case numbers, A-Numbers, DS-160, DS-260, VAC and consular interview dates in one client file.
home.audTab2Point1: Dedicated consular filing fields (USCIS, NVC, consular and VAC appointments).
home.audTab2Point2: Structured petitioner, beneficiary records, and required document vault.
home.audTab2Point3: 100% Offline access in consular waiting rooms or during client intake.
home.audTab3Title: Lease contracts, security deposits, and property sales.
home.audTab3Desc: Keep full control of each leased or transferred property. Manage tenants, landlords, security deposits, lease terms, and receive automated notifications for annual rent adjustments.
home.audTab3Point1: Automated alerts for lease expirations and statutory annual rent increases.
home.audTab3Point2: Real estate transactions with title registry and lien verification.
home.audTab3Point3: Secure vault for signed lease agreements, inventories, and payment receipts.
home.pillarsTitle: Your clients trust your discretion. Their files do not belong in the cloud.
home.pillarsSubtitle: Web platforms store confidential legal matters on third-party servers exposed to data breaches, outages, and compliance violations. Lexbell is built on an absolute principle: your data remains encrypted strictly on your machine.
home.pillar1Desc: Honor your legal confidentiality duty. All your legal matters, court notes, and files reside encrypted with SQLite on your local hard drive. Nobody else has the keys.
home.pillar2Desc: The groundbreaking relationship graph automatically reveals cross-connections between prospective clients, counterparties, companies, and firm history before taking a case.
home.pillar3Desc: Prepare trial notes in courtrooms without Wi-Fi, draft filings on flights, or query files in milliseconds. Zero web browser lag and automatic daily backups.
home.modulesTitle: A comprehensive workspace designed by and for litigators.
home.modulesSubtitle: Every screen in Lexbell was engineered to eliminate administrative friction and ensure absolute procedural precision.
home.m1Title: Matters organized by legal practice area with instant search.
home.m1Desc: Structure your practice across Civil, Criminal, Labor, Corporate, Real Estate, and Administrative matters. Record docket numbers, assigned courts, opposing counsels, and parties with instant filters and lightning-fast global search (⌘E / Ctrl+E).
home.m1Point1: Filter by procedural stage, matter type, and court.
home.m1Point2: Claimants, defendants, counterparties, and representation tracking.
home.m1Point3: Chronological hearing history and confidential internal notes.
home.m2Title: Never miss a statutory deadline or court hearing again.
home.m2Desc: Integrated legal calendar connected directly to every case. View scheduled appearances by month or week, paired with native desktop notifications so no critical deadline ever lapses.
home.m2Point1: Automated statutory deadline and court cutoff alerts.
home.m2Point2: Integrated hearing schedule with monthly and weekly overviews.
home.m2Point3: Native desktop notifications with zero internet requirement.
home.m3Title: Detect conflicts of interest instantly with the Relationship Map.
home.m3Desc: Lexbell's interactive network graph reveals overlapping connections between individuals, corporations, and previous cases. Identify ethical incompatibilities before signing representation agreements.

faq.title: Clear answers about Lexbell.
faq.subtitle: Everything about our local privacy model, licensing, performance, and cross-platform compatibility.
faq.q1: What is the Lexbell system and what is it used for?
faq.a1: Lexbell is a native desktop practice management software for solo attorneys and law firms that organizes case files, court deadlines, contacts, and legal documents 100% locally and encrypted on your Mac or Windows PC, protecting attorney-client privilege without relying on external cloud servers.
faq.q2: How much does Lexbell cost? Is there a free version?
faq.a2: You can start completely free with up to 50 active cases, with no time limits and no credit card required. For unlimited case files and advanced features, affordable monthly or annual plans are available without per-seat price gouging.
faq.q3: What is the difference between Lexbell and cloud software like Clio?
faq.a3: Unlike Clio or web-based practice management platforms that charge expensive per-user monthly subscriptions and store confidential client files on remote servers, Lexbell runs locally on your machine, guarantees attorney-client privilege by design, works 100% offline, and costs a fraction of the price.
faq.q4: Are my cases uploaded to the cloud?
faq.a4: No. All your information lives solely on your computer and never leaves it; the application never transmits case notes or documents to external servers. Confidentiality is completely preserved on your own hardware.
faq.q5: Does it work without an internet connection?
faq.a5: Yes. All matter management, deadline calculation, contact directory, and document tracking features work fully offline. Only initial download and store licensing checks require internet.
faq.q6: What happens to my client files if my laptop dies or breaks?
faq.a6: Your data is protected through automated local backups (daily, weekly, or monthly) saved to any drive, external USB, or local directory you choose. You can also export your full database to JSON and restore it onto a new machine in seconds.
faq.q7: Does it work the same on Mac and Windows?
faq.a7: Yes. It delivers the exact same native capabilities across macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel) and Windows (10/11 64-bit), adapting standard keyboard shortcuts: ⌘ on Mac and Ctrl on Windows.
faq.q8: What are the system requirements for Lexbell?
faq.a8: macOS 12 Monterey or later, or 64-bit Windows 10 and 11. It requires less than 150 MB of disk space and runs smoothly on standard modern computers.
faq.q9: Which countries and legal practice areas are supported?
faq.a9: Lexbell supports firms across Spanish- and English-speaking jurisdictions, with dedicated workflows for civil litigation, criminal, labor, immigration visa tracking, and real estate contracts.
faq.q10: Where can I officially download Lexbell?
faq.a10: Lexbell is officially and securely downloaded from the Apple Mac App Store for macOS and the Microsoft Store for Windows, providing certified code safety and automatic updates.
